facts.fact: Muthu brought Devan to the Resin House on horseback rather than by cart, and held the gatehouse arch against hunters while Devan's horse carried him into the yard.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Devan ride in held in the saddle, and Muthu fights at the gatehouse.

facts.fact: Ammu hid a flat blade in her braid, lifted Pachan's key ring and stole the antidote vial from Chathu's sleeve.
facts.why: needed because she must free Neela and return the vial without being seen.

facts.fact: Ammu learned the self-naming loophole at fourteen from a drunk old master and tells Neela the tappers' verse 'the name given back' refers to it.
facts.why: needed because it explains the verse planted in ch20 and Ammu's silence.

facts.fact: Devan's ribs reopen when he strikes Vellan, and Neela feels a brief tearing along her own side while in shape without yet understanding it.
facts.why: needed to foreshadow the wound-share that ch28 states at first light.

facts.fact: Ammu uses the jackal call 'tomorrow, I will find you' as her last signal before drawing Vellan and the hunters away.
facts.why: needed to echo F074 and give her death weight.
